headline: UK warns companies supplying Ukraine of an increased Russian sabotage threat
label: NEWS
caption:
British authorities are sounding the alarm over growing security risks to businesses. 🚨

According to Reuters and TRT World, the UK has warned companies supplying Ukraine of an increased Russian sabotage threat.

The warning highlights growing concerns over hostile state activities targeting supply chains and commercial operations linked to the conflict.

Officials are urging organizations to enhance their security measures and remain vigilant against potential disruptions.
